why: ./charts allocates Heatmap and BandStrip (symbols 7 and 8 of 10) and G4 freezes the charts API, so both must sit on the v3 core first. Consumers: argo time-of-day-chart (Heatmap), linewatch availability-strip and link-speed-strip (BandStrip).
what: git mv the 2.x Heatmap and BandStrip files into packages/basalt-ui/src/charts/parts/ and port them to the v3 core. One concern: these two kinds.
concept: docs/v3/concepts/charts-cards-kanban.md sections 5, 9 (S5), 10, 11 (foldBands internal to BandStrip; Donut killed).
contract: Props: if src/charts/contract.ts declares HeatmapProps and BandStripProps (grep), import them; else keep the types exported from the parts files and raise a factory signal. Never edit contract.ts. S5 failed iff d3-scale is in packages/basalt-ui/package.json peerDependencies (charts-1-core kept it).
exemplar: Sibling kinds in src/charts/parts/ (v3-charts-2-kinds, v3-charts-4-chartcard): layout, SSR box, phase handling, test placement.
change: git mv to lowercase targets: Heatmap.tsx to parts/heatmap.tsx, BandStrip.tsx to parts/band-strip.tsx, band-fold, heatmap-fill and their tests (band-strip, band-fold, band-legend, heatmap-fill) beside them, the Heatmap cases of donut-heatmap.test.tsx to parts/heatmap.test.tsx. The Donut cases stay in src/charts/donut.test.tsx (the renamed remainder); a later Issue retires Donut. Retarget to the core and the single host; replace Heatmap's scaleQuantize with the engine-scale quantize unless S5 failed. Absent stays distinct from zero; ariaLabel stays required. Export names are unchanged, so export-surface.json must not change; run gen-llms.ts and commit llms.txt only if --check was red. Rules: import-boundary and series-palette (existing). Skill snippet: the JSDoc @example on each kind (feeds llms.txt); references/charts is v3-sk-7-references. Tests: the five moved test files.
commits: One package commit in one PR: feat: add Heatmap and BandStrip parts. Conventional, empty scope, no attribution, no breaking footer.
proof: bun test over the moved files and make check; no screenshot round.
acceptance: make check exits 0, with scripts/export-surface/charts.json unchanged.
bun test over parts/{heatmap,band-strip,band-fold,band-legend}*.test.tsx and parts/heatmap-fill.test.ts passes.

Heatmap and BandStrip stay exported from src/charts/index.ts; Donut.tsx has no diff.
